title: Lightning Background
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.visual_review: Desktop and mobile screenshots inspected; fullscreen blue lightning, centered text, Reply control and inset frame verified.

asset_issues.issue: Not present at the supplied path
asset_issues.resolution: Implemented the supplied React demo and GLSL shader directly; no extraction or replacement needed.

notes: React 18, TypeScript and Vite; lucide-react dependency retained as specified.
Original shader, prop interface, demo values, copy and Reply Action alert preserved. Local CSS reproduces the supplied utility styles.
All production resources use the required /motionsites-results/community-superdesign-lightning-background/ base path.
No external font or image requests. Inline SVG favicon prevents a missing favicon request.
Browser checks used Chromium SwiftShader; physical GPU performance and other browser engines were not measured.
Ready for review; not deployed or pushed.
